The "Missing" status for your SIM card means the phone isn't detecting the card that allows you to connect to the cellular network. This is likely why you have no signal and can't send messages.

It doesn't necessarily mean something is wrong with the phone itself; it often just means the SIM card isn't seated correctly in the slot. I can help you resolve this by simulating a "reseat" of the SIM card, which is like taking it out and putting it back in properly.
